channel.title: The Apprentice
channel.desc: It's once upon a time in the boardroom as the candidates create a children's story and audiobook. One team takes on toilet humour but ends up with a stinky storyline. The others try to stand out from the herd with a zebra-themed tale, but tussles on the team threaten to stop their story in its tracks. In the boardroom, the fairy tale is over, and for one candidate, there is no happily ever after.
